data.one_liner: Animated, draggable reorderable ListView/GridView with built‑in swipe‑to‑delete.
data.what_it_does: Wraps any ListView or GridView to add drag‑and‑drop reordering, animated inserts/removals, and swipe‑to‑delete. Supports moving items between multiple lists or grids via AnimatedReorderableGroup.
use_when: You need a sortable list or grid with smooth animations
You want to move items between several lists (e.g., a kanban board)
You need built‑in swipe‑to‑delete without extra widgets
avoid_when: You require drag handles, headers/footers, or sliver‑based lists
You only need simple reordering without animations
You need platform‑specific drag‑and‑drop APIs not covered by Flutter
strengths: Combines reorderable list and animated list features
Works with both ListView and GridView
weaknesses: No sliver version; cannot be used inside CustomScrollView

alternatives.name: flutter_slidable
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides flexible swipe‑to‑delete and other slide actions without full reorderable functionality
